recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-37616 unless future generated output shows a rendering problem that is not reflected in source/languages.html.
issue_request: FHIR-37616 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for the languages page. It asked to remove leading '#' characters from anchor names so generated fragment URLs would not contain doubled hashes, and it also noted a broken prolog link to narrative.html#cfc.
initial_application: No combined-branch commit explicitly mentions FHIR-37616. Git history shows the anchor-name correction was applied implicitly by 0d58d10e724397da66de18b51936bc3c2702e4f7, which changed the languages page anchors from name="#..." to name="...". The stale prolog paragraph linking to narrative.html#cfc had already been removed by f12cbe36661085046c474860129f42357b7e4a16, an Apply FHIR-22695 commit.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2022-07-25 record FHIR-37616 as a technical correction that would be fixed. source/hierarchy.xml includes languages.html in the current build, and the combined branch currently has matching single-hash hrefs and anchor names without leading '#'. No Zulip discussion or additional Confluence FTS hit was found beyond the approval minutes.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current source already satisfies the requested correction. No source file was changed.

related_jiras.note: A prior source commit labeled Apply FHIR-22695 removed the languages-page prolog paragraph and narrative.html#cfc link that FHIR-37616 also mentioned.
